title: Fraud/enforcement peer contagion: directional, fail-closed declared-universe revision

data_and_methodology.methodology_type: empirical event study; descriptive/predictive association, not causal
data_and_methodology.event_source: hand-curated public revelation calendar from K1677/events.csv; not full AAER population
data_and_methodology.price_source: K1677 cached yfinance daily OHLCV, auto_adjust=False
data_and_methodology.primary_peer_policy: event-specific declared list, focal ticker excluded, strict 49/49 pre-return + 10/10 post-return and full OHLCV; complete-event drop if any declared peer fails
data_and_methodology.sensitivity_peer_policy: available declared peers, explicitly labelled; never substitutes current survivors
data_and_methodology.multiple_testing: directional one-sided Bonferroni+BH separately over pre-declared m=8; claim requires iid-BH, CR1 cluster-BH+Bonferroni, cluster-sign-flip BH all <.05 plus cluster t>=3
data_and_methodology.time_dependence: CR1 connected components of overlapping full [-60,+10] windows (origin gap <= 70 trading steps); cluster sign-flip sensitivity

five_fixes.directional_tests: all eight outcomes sign-oriented; one-sided iid/cluster tests and BH(m=8)
five_fixes.peer_universe_fail_closed: focal ticker assertion + frozen event-specific declared peers + strict complete-event primary; missing peers/events fully reported; not represented as a licensed historical-universe reconstruction
five_fixes.clean_placebo: historical-only candidate [-60,+10] window must end before focal baseline and cannot overlap any real event [-60,+10] window; both audits asserted zero
five_fixes.measure_definitions: standard E[min(r,0)^2]; Amihud full-series pct_change before slicing retains t+1
five_fixes.time_cluster_inference: calendar-time CR1, whole-cluster pairs CI, and 10,000 seeded cluster sign flips; no iid-only finding is called robust

honesty_caveats: Salient events are hand-curated, so results do not estimate average effects in the full SEC AAER population.
Peer lists are frozen event-specific declarations, not a licensed historical index-membership database.
Ticker-string focal exclusion cannot replace PERMCO/entity-level exclusion; no knowledge-grade claim about a fully reconstructed point-in-time industry universe is made.
Complete-case primary inference avoids silent survivor reweighting but can lose events with delisted peers; available-peer sensitivity is reported separately.
N<30 remains underpowered; cluster inference further reduces effective degrees of freedom.
Associations around revelation dates are not causal estimates.
Liquidity families are market-adjusted against contemporaneous SPY CS/Amihud changes; raw peer ratios remain diagnostics only.
